description: This file defines a custom exception class ClientNonPersonNotFoundException, which is thrown when client non-person resources are not found in the application. It extends an abstract exception class and provides a constructor to specify an error message with an identifier.

classes.name: ClientNonPersonNotFoundException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a non-person client resource was not found, specifically used for signaling invalid or missing resources by identifier.

methods.name: ClientNonPersonNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a specific error message integrating the provided 'id'.
